description: CPFS Runner as an MCP server — deterministic AI coding guardrails via a compiled WASM core.
name: io.github.JonahAlexanian/cpfs-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the workspace root CPFS will manage (defaults to the current working directory)
environmentVariables.name: CPFS_WORKSPACE

environmentVariables.description: Port for the CPFS dashboard web UI (defaults to 8765)
environmentVariables.name: CPFS_DASHBOARD_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to enable verbose debug logging
environmentVariables.name: CPFS_DEBUG
